now: verify reliable; reproduce reliable if a harness exists; edit reliable once the plan is frozen; review and onboard assisted

analyze.trigger: A failing path, stack trace, or error log is present and the owning file is unknown. Quiet when the ask is to edit, run tests, or explain the whole repo.
analyze.doneWhen: The map names the entry file from the failing path (file:line quoted from the trace), the one invariant the bug breaks, the files the change must not touch, and one log line quoted verbatim with its line number that proves the entry file ran. No matching log line is a valid result: write unmatched and stop.
analyze.forbidden: Guessing a file from a noisy log that the grep did not return; naming a file with no quoted line.

reproduce.trigger: A bug report and an existing test harness are present. Quiet when asked to fix it, or when no harness exists.
reproduce.doneWhen: The named smallest command (pytest or python3 -m unittest, one test id, pinned input file) exits non-zero before any edit, and the report quotes the actual output line next to the expected value. git status shows no edited file. No harness is a valid result: report harness absent and stop.
reproduce.forbidden: Editing source to make the failure appear, or reporting a failure that was not run red.

edit.trigger: A frozen plan lists the files to change and any signature change. Quiet when no plan exists or the plan is still open.
edit.doneWhen: git diff --name-only lists exactly the files named in the plan and no others, public signatures are unchanged unless the plan says so, and each non-obvious hunk carries a one-line note. An empty diff is a valid result when the plan needs no change.
edit.forbidden: Drift: editing an unnamed file, renaming a public signature, or tidying beyond the plan.

verify.trigger: A project directory holds verify_gate.sh and a change claims to be finished. Also fires when the Stop hook asks whether work is done. Quiet when no gate script exists: report gate absent and stop.
verify.doneWhen: `bash verify_gate.sh` in the project directory exits 0 (unit test, then build, then render-compare against the fixture; the first failure stops it). The Stop hook blocks 'done' until it does.
verify.forbidden: declaring done, or editing any file, on a model read of the output; verify never fixes

migrate.trigger: One transform of one file shape applies to many files. Quiet for a single file, or when two different shapes are mixed.
migrate.doneWhen: git ls-files filtered by the shape lists N target files, and the verifier report shows rechecked N/N with every transformed file rechecked on its own isolated copy. Any file without a recheck is rejected and counted out. N of 0 is a valid result.
migrate.forbidden: Guessing the file list instead of enumerating it, or accepting a file whose result was not rechecked.

review.trigger: A diff or pull request is present. Quiet when asked to fix the code or to run tests.
review.doneWhen: Every comment carries file:line and the quoted line text, the quote appears verbatim at that line in git diff output, and each comment is typed logic, security, or performance. Any comment with no matching quote is dropped; zero surviving comments is a valid result.
review.forbidden: Posting a comment that cannot point at a line, or over-commenting style; cross-file logic no single line shows is reported unsupported, not smoothed.

onboard.trigger: A named request or endpoint and a runtime log are present. Quiet for explain-the-repo or architecture overview asks.
onboard.doneWhen: The trace lists one entry, each hop to the store with the owning module and a quoted file:line, and exactly one hop matched to a verbatim runtime log line with its log line number. No matching log line is a valid result: report log unmatched and stop. Output ends after that one flow.
onboard.forbidden: Touring the repo: describing modules that are not on the traced request path.
